name: Mechanism
desc: Minimalist clockwork interlude. Glitched IDM braindance tides under luminous nested epicycles — precise, articulated, mechanical. Written as the calm-but-intricate set that sits BEFORE a euphoric peak; it makes the drop that follows land harder. In the original show it ran Am -> C phrygian -> A major, with this set as the A-minor hinge.
notes: NOT the set Gene liked — he named 'Mechanism' from memory but on replay identified [[set.weight]] (gqom) as the one he wanted. Keep this as a valid vocabulary entry, not a taste signal. genart.epicycles is budget:light (~57-63fps) so it survives a loaded machine. Style MUST stay off 'blueprint'/'ink' (monochrome -> strobe risk); 'spectral-glow' is the safe, colorful default. Followed well by kit.trance_anthem x arc.build_drop (A major = Picardy third against this set's A minor).
